title: Governed Agentic AI for ITSM – A Practical Blueprint
description:
A vendor-neutral reference architecture and engineering artefact collection for governing agentic AI in IT Service Management: typed tool contracts with safety metadata, executable OPA/Rego policies, evidence schemas with plan-hash binding and context-freshness admission, governance mappings, and an autonomy maturity model.

Companion repository to the IEEE Software article Governed Agentic AI in IT Service Management (doi:10.1109/MS.2026.3725235). The article cites release v0.3.0.
